digest.component_or_area: test harness / store isolation subprocess helper
propositions: The nested pytest subprocess launched from tests/_store_isolation.py without a private --basetemp argument joins the user-global numbered temp root, causing pytest session cleanup to synchronously scan and delete stale retained trees which can consume the entire 90-second child timeout after test execution completes.

Controlled filesystem A/B testing with 400,000 stale entries in the shared numbered root demonstrates cleanup cost scales with retention: private --basetemp child completed in 0.882s while shared-root child took 10.800s, and SIGUSR1 stack traces captured the main thread in pytest cleanup_numbered_dir during post-[100%] boundary.

The repair provides the nested pytest child a caller-owned tmp_path/nested-pytest basetemp via --basetemp flag without changing test selection, environment, capture, timeout, or ambient-store assertions; real-subprocess regression oracle confirms this prevents sentinel deletion across runs.

Stress testing with the repair shows 25/25 nested pytest runs passed without timeout while a 200,000-entry poisoned shared root remained unchanged, and mutation testing (omitting --basetemp) returns the sentinel test to RED before restoration to GREEN.
